faq_heading: Homes near William Watson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the William Watson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the William Watson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names William Watson Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near William Watson Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 77 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,395,000, townhomes $785,000, condos $424,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near William Watson Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of William Watson Elementary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 97.6% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 77 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to William Watson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Walnut Road Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Coast Meridian Elementary (1.0 km north-east) and Frost Road Elementary (1.4 km north).

William Watson Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16450 80 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names William Watson Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the William Watson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names William Watson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of William Watson Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 77 homes sold within 1 km of William Watson Elementary: 26 houses, 45 townhomes and 6 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $785,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of William Watson Elementary

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of William Watson Elementary in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Walnut Road Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Serpentine Heights Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Fleetwood Park Secondary (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Gobind Sarvar School (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Coast Meridian Elementary (1.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Walnut Road Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Coast Meridian Elementary (1.0 km north-east), Frost Road Elementary (1.4 km north), Coyote Creek Elementary (1.8 km west), St Matthew's Elementary (1.9 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Walnut Road Elementary, 0.7 km north-west of William Watson Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near William Watson Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from William Watson Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near William Watson Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 1 km of William Watson Elementary was $785,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Walnut Road Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km north-west of William Watson Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
